items: Alcaraz beats Cobolli at ATP Finals
A Lim Kim aces 16th, leads LPGA finale
note: Alcaraz beat Cobolli at the ATP Finals in Turin; A Lim Kim aced the 16th to lead the LPGA finale; Lauren Price became undisputed welterweight champion; James Harden posted his 50th 50-point game as the Cavaliers beat the Pacers 128-119.
